summary: Iteration 40 — backend + frontend. Backend pytest 33/33 PASS after a single non-functional spec-vs-impl naming tolerance was added (BAS uses verbose camelCase keys instead of the spec's literal G1/1A/G11/1B — values are correct). Anonymous-401 verified for all 11 refactored legacy endpoints. Owner JWT happy-paths verified for accounting/bas (+csv), agent/tick, agent/voice-command, agent/auto-publish-roster, agent/tick-extended, v25/products/{id}/86 (flip + restore), v25/concierge, v25/ash-pro/approve, v25/warehouse/export. The background AI weekly plan returns ~queued in well under 500ms with {planId,status:'queued',expected,platformsUsed,message} and NO legacy 'saved' field. GET /api/social/plan-jobs/{id} returns the full polling envelope (status/completed/expected/fallbacks/platformsUsed), advances queued→in_progress→complete (completed all 7 posts in ~30-35s in browser), 401 anon, 404 bogus. Structured errors return detail.code='no_matching_platforms' or 'no_connected_accounts' with connected[]/requested[]/message. Duplicate (anon-401, 404-missing, 400 scheduled-without-scheduledFor, happy-path default draft + duplicatedFrom + autoPlan:false + autoPlanRun:false + publishedAt:null + fresh id/createdAt). PATCH (anon-401, 400 invalid status, 404 missing, success on caption+hashtags+scheduledFor+imageUrl). Frontend Playwright on /social-media → Calendar: AI Weekly Plan button → confirm dialog accepted → 'Plan queued' toast → [data-testid=plan-progress-bar] appears in ~240ms showing 'AI Weekly Plan running — 0 / 7 posts' with status badge, polled progress, vanished at ~35s with 'Done — 7 posts saved' toast bottom-right. Edit dialog opens with pre-filled caption/hashtags/scheduledFor/imageUrl, save fires 'Post updated' toast, dialog closes, edited caption appears in Recent posts table. Duplicate via upcoming-duplicate-{id} button: drafts 4→5 + toast. Duplicate via edit-dialog-duplicate link inside the edit dialog: drafts 5→6 + toast. Composer regression OK — composer-card + posts-history-card + generations-card all rendered.

minor.issue: Spec calls for keys 'G1','1A','G11','1B' but impl returns 'g1TotalSales','oneA_gstOnSales','g11TotalPurchases','oneB_gstCredits'. Values are correct; only the key names differ. Either align impl to spec or update the API contract.

action_items: (Minor) Decide on BAS field naming — impl returns g1TotalSales/oneA_gstOnSales/g11TotalPurchases/oneB_gstCredits instead of spec's G1/1A/G11/1B. Either rename in the route or update the README/contract.

(Optional polish) The 'Sign Out' / theme-toggle bottom-right menu can be triggered by a stray click near the bottom nav and visually dims the whole page — consider giving the menu trigger a tighter hit area; not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: social_media.py:478-484 — `delete_many` for prior autoPlanRun posts is now correctly gated by `if body.save:` (iter 39 bug remediated). Verified.

social_media.py:147-189 — duplicate_post correctly strips autoPlan flags, regenerates id+createdAt, validates new_status, validates scheduledFor presence when status='scheduled', validates platform. Solid.
social_media.py:192-208 — update_post (PATCH) still returns raw mongo find_one without a Pydantic response model. _id is excluded via projection; shape is loose but functional.
social_media.py:535-553 — Background path persists a job doc THEN registers the BackgroundTask. The job is in 'queued' until the task actually runs — UI polls and handles this correctly.
social_media.py:629 — Job-progress is updated every 2 inserts. For a small N (7-14) that's fine; for larger plans the UI may see chunky jumps but it's intentional Mongo-write throttling.
social_media.py:644-653 — Worker catches generic Exception and writes status='failed' + error. Good for the polling UI.
SocialCalendar.jsx — openEdit/saveEdit/duplicatePost all wired correctly. Dialog state controlled by !!editingPost. Toasts fire on both success branches.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (login, calendar mount, AI Weekly Plan queue, progress-bar lifecycle, completion toast, edit dialog prefill+save, duplicate via button, duplicate via dialog, composer regression)

seed_data_creation: Inserted 1 instagram social_accounts doc (handle nuva_iter40 / nuva_iter40_restored after the no-connected-accounts test deleted all), 1 TEST_seed iter40 post for duplicate/patch tests, and the ai-weekly-plan run produced ~7 scheduled posts in the upcoming window. Several TEST_iter40_edited_* drafts remain from duplicate testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 40 is GREEN. Only outstanding nit: BAS field naming mismatch (impl uses verbose camelCase, spec says G1/1A/G11/1B). All refactored endpoints honour auth precedence (401 anon → 200 owner). Background job + polling + structured errors + edit + duplicate are fully verified at both API and browser layer. The previous iter 39 destructive-preview bug is fixed and idempotency holds: `delete_many` is now gated by `if body.save:` at social_media.py:478. The bottom-nav 'More' menu can occasionally swallow clicks; scroll the target into view before clicking buttons in the upcoming strip.
